cohort: Mothers with placenta previa (n=452) and a control group of mothers who underwent cesarean delivery without placenta previa (n=18,617)
finding: While increased maternal morbidity was observed in mothers with placenta previa, neonatal morbidities were only associated with preterm delivery.
gest_age: Neonates born to mothers with placenta previa had lower gestational ages.
birth_weight: Neonates born to mothers with placenta previa had lower birth weights.
